missionSettings.description:
NEEDS: NOCustomMaps 1.4+ and the Cascadia map, build cm.cascadia.2546c698 (install "Cascadia Falling" with the Nuclear Option Mod Manager, or put cascadia-0.1.0.nomapz in BepInEx\plugins\NOCustomMaps\maps). Everyone in a session needs that same map build. Optional: NOGridLetters for readable grid callouts.

Cascadia Falling. PALA attacks Puget Sound from the Pacific and the Strait of Georgia; BDF defends from Tacoma. PvP: both sides can be joined.

BDF starts with nearly everything: 9 airfields, 4 FOBs, 7 pads, 4 nuclear silo fields, two Hyperion carriers at three naval bases and picket pairs across the Sound. PALA holds CFB Comox and has two carrier groups at sea from T+0, each 1 Hyperion, 2 Argus, 2 Dynamo, 4 corvettes and an Annex: one entering the Strait of Juan de Fuca from the Pacific (grid P8) steaming east, one at the top of the Strait of Georgia (grid E12) steaming south through Rosario Strait. They meet off Port Townsend, then push through Admiralty Inlet and down the Sound in line astern, the western force to Commencement Bay off Tacoma and the northern to Elliott Bay off Seattle. A new group enters on each axis every ten minutes from T+20 to T+120, each a little further out than the one before, and follows the same track, carrier groups again at T+30 and T+70 and four-ship surface groups between, and the carriers launch AI aircraft all mission. Then come high-altitude Alkyon anti-ship strikes and Darkreach packages, landing craft at Port Angeles and Birch Bay, I-5 and mountain columns, Tarantula lifts dropping 6x6 AA onto the pads with Brawler and Revoker cover, and from T+95 nuclear strike packages on the silo fields. Everything PALA captures builds for PALA.

BDF wins by sinking all 6 assault carriers (the last arrives at T+70) or holding JBLM, Fort Lewis FOB, the Port of Tacoma and the Narrows until T+150. PALA wins by taking those four; every other BDF airfield, FOB, pad and naval base is a PALA objective on the way, and each silo field is one to put out of action. Strategic release comes at T+90 and arms the 24 silo launchers.

Map key cm.cascadia.2546c698. Map and plugin: github.com/netmaster296/CascadiaFalling.

objectives.DisplayName: Take Tacoma: JBLM, Fort Lewis FOB, the port and the Narrows
Destroy the Yakima Training Center silo field
Destroy the Nisqually Prairie silo field

outcomes.Message: Stealth strike, wave 2. Same package at Nisqually Prairie from the west and at Yakima from the east corridor.

The push on Tacoma. Everything converges: the I-5 column from the north, Kitsap across the Narrows, the fleets into Commencement Bay, a third stealth wave at whichever silo field is still standing. Heli-lift onto Vashon.
Border crossing. I-5 column crosses at Blaine toward Bellingham. Hwy 1 column leaves Hope ten minutes later and joins it.

First landings. Assault carriers put landing craft ashore at Ediz Hook (Port Angeles) and Birch Bay. Port Angeles and Bellingham airfields are the objectives; both flip to PALA and their factories start building PALA units.

Heli-lift, wave 1. 2 UtilityHelo1 each carrying a heavy SAM (both cargo bays), 2 Chicane escorts, 2 A-19 Brawler and 2 Revoker CAS: Friday Harbor pad from the west, Fort Worden pad from the north. The SAM lands on the pad and locks the point before any ground unit gets there.

Second landings. Dungeness and Sidney (Victoria) from the west; Oak Harbor from the north. NAS Whidbey is assaulted from the beach and the air. Vancouver falls to a detachment and starts producing for PALA.

First naval strike. 3 Alkyon (AShM3 x4 internal) enter at the NW corridor at 30,000 ft and strike the Admiralty Inlet picket. 2 Darkreach (AShM3 internal) + 1 Medusa + 2 Ifrit escort from the N corridor strike the Rosario Strait picket.
Strike on Paine Field. 3 Darkreach (bomb_500 x8) + 2 Medusa + 4 Ifrit on the Boeing plant factories and Marysville FOB. 3 Alkyon at 30,000 ft on the Tacoma fleet.
Hood Canal. LZ Bangor in Hood Canal (the fleet stays in the Strait). Kitsap FOB and the shipyard under attack. Second heli-lift wave: Hurricane Ridge and Coupeville.
Third carrier group. A third carrier group enters on each axis, behind the surface groups that have been arriving every ten minutes since the first fleet.

Seattle. Landings at Mukilteo and Bainbridge. Darkreach raid on the Everett carrier group if it still exists. Heli-lift onto Bainbridge and the Kitsap FOB. Seattle is attacked from the north (I-5), the west (Bainbridge) and the air.

Strategic release. Message: 'Strategic release granted.' The 24 silo launchers spawn armed in the four fields. From here BDF nuclear TBMs fire at PALA concentrations whenever the escalation score allows.
Stealth strike, wave 1. 2 clean-wing Ifrit (internal nuclear) with 1 Medusa ahead and 2 ace Vortex above, from the nearest corridor at the Sedro-Woolley and Matlock silo fields.
Strategic release granted. The silo fields are armed: Nisqually Prairie, Matlock, Sedro-Woolley, Yakima.

Cascadia Falling. PALA fleets are inbound through the Strait of Juan de Fuca and the Strait of Georgia. BDF holds the Sound and must keep Tacoma. Captured fields build for whoever holds them.

Tacoma held. Relief forces are crossing the Columbia.
